title: Move between pages with Link
summary: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes.
introduction: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes. Your task: Add a Link from the book page back to the home page.
learningObjectives: Add a Link from the book page back to the home page.
Explain the example for move between pages with link

blocks.text: Next.js Link makes navigation between local routes. It preserves normal link meaning while allowing the framework to handle the move.

Use a Next.js App Router project. Save files at the paths shown. For these static examples, use output: "export" in next.config.ts and npm run build. They need Next.js tools and do not run in this playground.
